transcript_tail.text: Is there any impact to main if we merge domain? No. I meant merge to main.

**No meaningful impact on a running main.** The changes are purely additive:

- **Phase 1** — `analyze_action`/`investigator_prompt_advise` got an optional `transcript_tail=None` parameter. Every live call site (manager loop, manager-ui's analyze button, the executor) passes None, so the rendered prompt is byte-identical to before. Tests assert this explicitly.
- **Phase 2** — net-new endpoint (`POST /api/test_case`), net-new UI button + modal (only opens on click), net-new module (`eval_cases.py`, imported only by the new endpoint + tests), net-new config property (`test_cases_dir`, only read inside the new endpoint), net-new dir (`tests/manager_cases/`, no test discovery touches it — they're JSON, not `test_*.py`). The only edit to existing markup is the CSS selector `#gpanel` → `#gpanel,#tcpanel`, which just adds the same modal-overlay rules to the new panel.

**One operational thing to flag:** the running `manager-ui` and `manager` launchd services load code at process start. After the merge they'll keep using the old code until you `launchctl kickstart -k` them (same gotcha as `feedback_supervisor_restart_on_nickname_change`). Without that restart the new button and endpoint won't appear — but nothing breaks either.
